subject: Adding Participant's username and email address in exports
body:
Good morning Alison,

My name is Mohammad and I will be happy to help you with this question.

You can download the list of participants including their Avicenna ID, their name, and their email address as a CSV file from the Participation tab of the dashboard. Then you can link them with the Avicenna ID that you see in the data export files.

We have not included these data directly in the data export file for two reasons:

1. To reduce the size of the file. Specially for exports with many rows, this can increase the file size unnecessarily.
2. Having participant info in another file gives better control to prevent leaking of personally identifiable information.

Hope it answers your question 

Best,
Mohammad
